{{Quote|Uh...where did you come from?|The droid, amazed to see [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Nomad Droids">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref>}}
This '''battle droid''' was stationed on [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Patitite Pattuna)/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] at the time of the [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Battle of Patitite Pattuna]].

==Biography==
After General Grievous ordered that the [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)/Legends|unidentified pirate ship]] be destroyed, R2-D2 and C-3PO were sucked out into space through a hole in the pirate ship caused by a hit from Grievous's [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]. R2 used his rocket boosters to ferry himself and C-3PO aboard Grievous' ship, where a reception committee of battle droids awaits them, including this droid and a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 3 (Patitite Pattuna)|fellow B1 droid]]. At first, this droid was amazed to see C-3PO and R2 and asked where they had come from. A fellow droid then suggested they might be pirate droids. Hearing that, this droid told R2 and C-3PO they were under arrest.
While at first C-3PO denied that he and R2 were pirate droids, after being prompted by R2, he admitted they were pirates. This droid then sent them to the incinerator room to be melted down for replacement parts.
